EffortEstimate.description:
T-shirt-size effort estimate for a single SP conversion.

``size`` is the Stage E roll-up; ``factors`` is the per-axis weighting
that produced it (e.g. ``{"cyclomatic": 0.4, "side_effects": 0.2,
"table_touch_count": 0.3, "cross_db_link": 0.1}``). Keeping ``factors``
free-form (``dict[str, float]``) lets the calibration in
``docs/m4-effort-calibration.md`` (M4-11) evolve without re-shaping the
persisted record.
EffortEstimate.title: EffortEstimate

description:
Top-level migration plan produced by the M4 pipeline.

Schema-versioned so downstream primitives can refuse to consume a
mismatched output (design spec §"File contract" rule). ``target`` is
the built-in target Literal; the CLI also accepts entry-point-
registered third-party targets at the registry layer, but those are
not part of the persisted ``Target`` Literal — third-party plugins
persist their selection as a free-form ``target_name`` extension
field on the renderer side rather than mutating this enum.

The fields after ``target`` are the per-stage outputs the Stage B
plan synthesizer (`shared/plan_synthesizer.py`, M4-7) fills in:

- ``data_deps`` — list of M1 ``Table.name`` strings the SP touches,
  validated against the M1 ``SchemaDigest`` at orchestrator time
  (anti-hallucination guard, SPEC §"Anti-hallucination").
- ``txn_boundaries`` — natural-language descriptions of where the
  original SP's ``COMMIT`` / ``ROLLBACK`` should map to the target
  framework's transactional boundary (e.g. Spring ``@Transactional``,
  FastAPI dependency).
- ``side_effect_mappings`` — keyed by M2 ``SideEffect`` literal
  (``email`` / ``file`` / ``external`` / ``dynamic_sql``), valued by
  the target-framework's API choice (e.g. ``email`` →
  ``JavaMailSender``).
- ``test_plan`` — per-stage test cases the engineer should add to
  the generated scaffold.
- ``gotchas`` — known migration risks (cursor → stream translation,
  cross-DB link replacement, vendor pragma loss).
- ``commit_sequence`` — suggested commit sequence for the human
  engineer, referenced by ``StoredProc.name`` from the M2 digest
  (anti-hallucination guard).

Gemini subset (issue #548 / SPEC §6.3 + §7.2): persisted M4 artefact,
not an LLM ``response_format`` schema. Pydantic emits ``$ref`` for
the nested ``EffortEstimate`` and ``additionalProperties: <schema>``
for the ``side_effect_mappings`` / ``EffortEstimate.factors`` dict
fields — both exceed Gemini's accepted subset. Decorated with
``@accepts_extended_schema`` because the plan is written to disk for
downstream consumption (commit-sequence runner, scaffold generator),
not sent through harness structured-output mode.
title: ConversionPlan
